_comment: Streets a rule proposes but that were reviewed and rejected; run.py drops them. Keep a reason for each.

vocabulary.Sint-Annaziekenhuislaan: a hospital named after the saint, not the saint's street
vocabulary.Reedijk: more likely a surname or place name than a roe deer
vocabulary.Valkhof: probably a place name rather than a falcon

titles.Ter Vorseldreef: 'Ter Vorsel' may be a place or estate name rather than a surname
titles.Van Gorkumlaan: Gorkum is the old name of Gorinchem: may lead to the town, not name a person
titles.Van Strijenstraat: Strijen is a Dutch town; may be a directional road rather than a surname

osm_etymology.Jupiterweg: the OSM tag says juniper; the buurten (Loovelt: planets and gods; an industrial estate) point to Jupiter

name_resolver.Schellingstraat: Schelling the philosopher, not the coin (ambiguous across gemeenten)
name_resolver.Philipsweg: label 'Philips (industrial family)' came from a famous-people entry typed as scientist; not established for this street
